crawler.name: Crawler
crawler.hint: Hunts you down two hexes at a time, and strikes as soon as it is next to you.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.hint: Holds its post and hits hard up close. Hit it from range twice and it comes after you. Once it is the last one left, it hunts you down.

ghost_process.name: Ghost Process
ghost_process.hint: Closes in until it has a clear shot within 3 hexes, then keeps shifting position between shots. Walls block its shots.
